name: Isabel Wiseler-Lima - § 27 - Am 80
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 27.Recognises universal jurisdiction as an important tool of the international criminal justice system to prevent and combat impunity and promote international accountability; calls on the Member States to actively apply universal jurisdiction in the fight against impunity, particularly in cases of systematic human rights violations, state-sponsored terrorism and repression, such as the acts committed by the Lukashenka regime in Minsk; emphasises that universal jurisdiction should serve as a vital legal mechanism to prosecute perpetrators when national or international judicial avenues are obstructed or ineffective; urges enhanced cooperation between national and international judicial bodies to strengthen legal frameworks, facilitate evidence-sharing and ensure that those responsible for grave human rights violations are held accountable, regardless of where the crimes were committed;
